record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly set learning rate to 0.001 and dropout to 0.10, retaining batch size 128 and all other settings. Larger updates may accelerate adaptation of the independently parameterized input/output embeddings, while reduced dropout preserves their unit-normalized recurrent signal. Keep embedding design, loss, GRU topology, readout, seeds and training caps fixed.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, jointly increase learning rate from 0.0007 to 0.001 and reduce dropout from 0.15 to 0.10. Larger updates may accelerate adaptation while lower dropout preserves recurrent input signal. Retain batch size 128, embedding parameterization, GRU topology, loss, readout and training caps. Enforce the required DATA_DIR environment contract. Predictor architecture and checkpoint shapes remain compatible.
